property_summary: For any caller sending exactly 10 ether to C's payable fallback at an increasing timestamp, the reference contract drains its entire balance to the caller exactly when block.number % 15 == 0 (so address(c).balance == 0 after the call iff block.number % 15 == 0); the mutant inverts the condition and will instead drain when block.number % 15 != 0, violating this rule for some block numbers.
change_summary: Invert the if condition so transfer happens when block.number % 15 != 0, altering transfer timing and thus observable balances after calls.
